name: Dot-Swarm
description: Shared .swarm/ stigmergy plugin. Injects a size+staleness STATUS line (not content) for .swarm/state.md + queue.md (and any configured peer files) into the agent's memory section via registerMemoryPromptSupplement (non-exclusive — coexists with the memory-core kind:"memory" backend, does not replace it); points at swarm_read / memory_search for the real content. Also provides the swarm_read + compact agent tools and the swarm-compact CompactionProvider (handoff-driven context compaction backed by .swarm/state.md).

contracts._doc: REQUIRED for agent-tool exposure (openclaw 2026.7.1 plugins/tools.ts:566-634): registerTool'd tools materialize ONLY if declared here. Without this, swarm_read + compact were never agent-callable (CLAW-076 find, 2026-08-03). Keep in sync with the api.registerTool names in index.ts.

swarmDir.description: Directory containing .swarm/ trail files. Default: $PWD/.swarm if it exists, else ~/.openclaw/.swarm

includeFiles.description: Files within swarmDir to inject into the memory prompt (default: ["state.md", "queue.md"])

maxBytes.description: Total byte cap across all files returned by the on-demand swarm_read tool. Default 32768. If exceeded, files are truncated with a marker. Does NOT apply to the memory-prompt supplement, which is status-only (size + staleness, no content).

registerSwarmReadTool.description: If true, also register a swarm_read agent tool so the agent can re-read files mid-session (default: true)
